report_notes: React HTTP 1.11.1 uses a return-type-only PSR-7 v2 compatibility patch isolated to its Docker image; Amp HTTP Server is 3.4.6 with Revolt 1.0.9. Both use 20 Supervisor-managed PHP processes, SO_REUSEPORT, TCP_NODELAY, Event 3.1.6, and recycling after 10,000 requests. Yii and PDO handling remains synchronous, with per-request state reset and native request concurrency limited to one per process. This separate October 8 session uses the same PHP 8.5.11 and load settings as the earlier measurements; existing runtimes were not rerun.

Both runtimes recorded socket read errors while recycling workers. Amp also recorded non-success HTTP responses; its native graceful shutdown can send 503 responses to queued requests. All recorded errors are retained and reduce successful RPS using the existing report calculation. No PHP application errors were logged during measurement.
